_comment: Stations archived by the collector. This is deliberately a SUPERSET of the
v1 launch set (SPEC section 10 ships one quantity at a small set of buoys).
Archiving is kilobytes per station per day and NDBC history older than 45
days is unrecoverable, so collect broadly now and choose the launch league
set later from real coverage numbers. Adding a station here is cheap;
wishing you had added it six months ago is impossible.
'launch_candidate: true' marks the ones under consideration for v1.
Water-temperature coverage per station is reported by the collector run

Stations with region 'sentinel_np' are NOT leagues and never host a round. They sit thousands of km upstream and exist to see a swell days before it reaches the launch set. launch_candidate is false for all of them.

stations.name: Gulf of Alaska
stations.notes: 3383 km upstream. Winter NW swell source region; 2.5-3.9 day travel time to SoCal depending on period.

stations.name: Southeast Papa
stations.notes: 1868 km upstream. Mid-path check on North Pacific swell, 33h-2.1d out.

stations.name: California Offshore
stations.notes: 1158 km upstream. Last deep-water look before the swell reaches the bight, 21-32h out.

stations.name: Northwestern Hawaii
stations.notes: 4345 km. Sees NW swell on the Hawaii great circle; a cross-check rather than a direct upstream point for SoCal.

stations.name: South of Hawaii
stations.notes: 4338 km. The best available southern-hemisphere sentinel, and not on the great-circle path from the Southern Ocean to SoCal - south swell is the weakest case for a buoy-based approach.
